_note: These five were identified while reading but were left out of 006 by mistake; commit b64ff20 named titolo and censo in its message without actually carrying them. Applied here.

rows._was: en was 'bond' with 'title' demoted. The financial sense is real --- the file has 'titolo di stato = government bond' --- but the everyday meaning is a title.
en was 'census'. False friend: a census is a censimento. censo is means or social standing.
en was 'claim'. The sinistro is the event itself; the claim made against it is the richiesta di risarcimento.
en was 'bottom/background'. sfondo is the background of an image or scene; 'bottom' belongs to fondo.
pos was adverb; spalancato is a participial adjective.
